The '''Elarian Trail''' was a road on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that led from the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to the ruins of the ancient [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] temple-[[City/Legends|city]] [[Kaleth]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[horranth]]s were often seen along the trail, and the native [[Flesh Raider]]s sometimes staged ambushes from the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] along the path.
